name: CoNC-ExactTopo-v1
baseline: original v70 liquid_transfer_frozen, all backbone and refiner parameters frozen
arithmetic: signed32 COPY/ADD/SUB on the supplied ordered DAG; missing or unsupported inputs and signed overflow remain UNKNOWN; no inference-time labels or references
architecture: exact node and ordered-parent bit states plus exact three-way operand comparison; node MLP; global/query mean and query max; pooled CoNC context; zero-initialized residual logit fusion
control: identical architecture and parameter count, but only supplied literals have numeric values; computed nodes remain unknown
cache: reuse hash-checked original CoNC FP32 logits and explicitly approximate FP16 pooled context; do not use old numeric, rule, access-label or oracle features

runtime.precision: FP32 training, TF32 disabled; exact values int64 with explicit signed32 limits

evaluation.secondary: same 11342 common IDs as paper; precision recall specificity MCC AUROC AP
evaluation.bootstrap_unit: paired family groups with seeds averaged inside each replicate

test_gate: all six DEV selections complete and checkpoint hashes frozen before any new TEST scoring
interpretation: retrospective source-domain experiment on a known template-generated dataset; arithmetic exactness is conditional on the supplied graph and is separate from C semantics and detection accuracy
